messages:
isabel: quick postmortem follow-up from the 02:00 UTC KV OOM. short cause: persistent small-object retention + slab fragmentation after shard-sync refactor. putting up an ownership map + timelines. please reply with owner + ETA.

isabel: TL;DR actions (short):
A) emergency soft-evict toggle (canary) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 4h
B) targeted heap captures (3 nodes) + flamegraphs -> owner: ? -> ETA: 18h
C) add `kv.frag_signal` telemetry + dashboard -> owner: ? -> ETA: 8h
D) pointer-safety quick-audit for `shard-sync` commit -> owner: ? -> ETA: 36h
E) short-runbook for emergency rollback + manual eviction -> owner: ? -> ETA: 6h
F) scope allocator hardening RFC (if mitigations hold) -> owner: ? -> ETA: next sprint

tony: i'll take (A) and (E). plan: set `runtime.kv.soft_evict_pct = 85` in config, canary to 10% nodes in us-west1. add `/metrics evt:kv.soft_evict shard=%s pct=%d` log line. smoke script + rollback commands in PR. ETA 3h.

isabel: thx. tony, please include exact rollback criteria: p99 > baseline + 20% OR srv.oom.count > 0 OR eviction_error_rate spike > 50%. document the `redwood deploy rollback --service kv-runtime --to previous` command in the runbook.

kevin: i'll own (B) and (D) pairing with @sara. will run `rd-heap-sample --svc=kv --secs=90 --out=s3://dbg/kv/212345` on three recent-fail hosts and create flamegraphs. after uploads i'll do a grep for unsafe pointer casts around commit `b7f3a9`. ETA 14h.

sara: i'll help with the pointer audit and add a tiny fuzz test for pointer validity in shard-sync. if we see cast sites, we gate any allocator changes. ETA 24h for audit + test harness.

trace-bot: [automated] Created ticket MEM-10312 "KV OOM follow-up: frag signals + mitigations" link: https://issue.redwood/MEM-10312

isabel: (C) telemetry suggestion: metric `kv.frag_signal = free_frag_bytes / active_alloc_bytes` sampled 15s per shard; alert if > 0.27 for 10m. also emit `kv.small_alloc_rate` (allocs <256B per minute). add a dashboard with per-shard heatmap and tag traces.

kevin: will add those metrics to the agent and push to the perf pipeline. i'll put provisional panels in Grafana and link in the ticket. ETA 8h.

tony: PR opened: `tony/soft-evict-flag` https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/978. includes smoke script and the runbook snippet. canary in 25m.

isabel: nice. runbook must include emergency commands:
- force eviction on host: `echo force > /sys/kernel/debug/kv/evict`
- quick rollback: `redwood deploy rollback --service kv-runtime --to previous`
- restart sequence: `systemctl restart kv-runtime && tail -n 200 /var/log/kv/runtime.log`

sara: note: pointer audit will check memcpy/cast sites and do a quick Valgrind-style run on dev-dev with recent commit. if unsafe memory access is found we block allocator changes.

kevin: heap captures started on hosts alpha/beta/gamma. sample ids: hs-212345-a/b/c. uploading to s3 now.

trace-bot: [automated] Ticket MEM-10312 updated: tags {"kv-frag-2026","oom-followup"}

isabel: short decision rule after 48h: if `kv.frag_signal` falls > 20% and p99 stays within baseline+10% we schedule allocator RFC for next sprint. if not, escalate to a mitigation sprint and prioritize small-object pooling + slab class for <256B objects.

tony: can someone own alert tuning? we need reasonable noise thresholds before we escalate.

isabel: sara, can you own alert tuning and the dashboard? minor changes only. ETA 6h.

sara: yes. will reduce false positives by requiring 2-shard correlation and 5m sustained signal. adding Grafana links to the ticket.

kevin: uploads complete. flamegraphs fg-212345-1/2/3 linked in the ticket. starting pointer audit now.

tony: canary at 10% for 20m: seeing `kv.soft_evict` events at ~2/min for a few shards, no OOMs, p99 within baseline +4%. monitoring.

isabel: great. daily check-in pinned to the ticket. if any blocker ping me directly. thanks all. :thumbsup:
